notes.title: New Prices for Game Mode Currencies
notes.notes:
[p]With this year’s [i]Kongiversary[/i] event, we are introducing a shake-up in how we price Game Mode Currencies, such as Energy, Raid Shards, PvP Tickets, and more. Our intent with this change is to make buying these currencies directly feel more reasonable on any given day while still respecting the value of picking up currency bundles as a part of the shop’s weekly rotation.
[/p][p]First and foremost, you can still look forward to picking up legendary bundles, like Token Duffles, for 600 Gems in the shop each week. But, don’t expect to see them priced any lower than that, even during a major event like [i]Kongiversary[/i]. Instead, [u]we will be lowering the standard cost to buy these currencies directly from the shop to match the 25% discount[/u] you’re used to from the weekly rotation.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/b795d1e3fbf4ba371b31802ec236d775ab5d1d7c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We heard your feedback that buying Energy, as just one example, could feel pricey when compared to the weekly rotation offer. It currently costs 800 Gems for 400 Energy from the shop, or you can grab an Energy Pack from the weekly rotation which gives you the same amount of Energy for only 600 Gems. From [i]Kongiversary[/i] onwards, [u]we will be lowering the price of 400 Energy to 600 Gems[/u] to give you that discounted rate every day of the year. You will still be able to purchase the Energy Pack bundle for 600 Gems when it’s offered as part of the weekly rotation, but [u]this bundle will never be discounted lower than the cost of buying the same amount of Energy directly[/u].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/0f0ebb690e44bd6c941fb1527c02db530873f627.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope this will create a better spending experience for everyone who plays the game. Buying these bundles at their discounted rate each week has been a mainstay of the Bit Heroes experience for years now, and those discounted bundles will still be very valuable to players who want to save up for big pushes in the future. However, these changes should make buying a few more Xeals or Badges here and there to keep a good farming session going feel better no matter which day of the week you log in.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/1f25d36e6de466d37888b0b3aa1c4fd39995952c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Introducing the Lord’s Vanguard
notes.notes:
An all-new World Boss, Lord Malakrogg, is coming soon to Bit Heroes Quest! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/666860/view/524211581550067923]Previously[/url], we took a look at what makes this World Boss unique and the awesome new gear it is introducing to the game. This time, we’ll be learning more about the well-equipped and well-trained members of the [b]Lord’s Vanguard[/b]. This small, but elite, fighting force has invaded Silverstone City on Malakrogg’s orders to unleash a harmful mutating gas on its citizens.

[h2]New Rare Fusions[/h2]
Assisting the Lord’s Vanguard are two new Rare Fusions, [b]Toolbon[/b] and [b]Dexteriuz[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/49b2107873eb86fef6b69718ea943f2c3b828a92.png[/img]
Toolbons are friendly little fellows that just want to keep their friends in the Lord’s Vanguard in fighting shape. They aren’t much of a warrior on their own, but they have figured out that “hurting” is a lot like healing if you just take the time to do everything wrong.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/d71b55b99a9adb20cdde4b78372641eed9ab30fe.png[/img]
Dexteriuz are solitary individuals by design. They were built by Lord Malakrogg to hunt down and harvest the most interesting mutations while the Lord’s Vanguard assaults Silverstone City. All reports seem to suggest that Dexteriuz actually prefer this isolation. When they aren’t gathering new mutations that Lord Malakrogg can use to further his evolution, they can be seen partaking in various hobbies such as papercrafts, gardening, and very awkward attempts at knitting.

[h2]New Epic Fusions[/h2]
Three new Epic Fusions, [b]Warhead[/b], [b]Emperor Freudrich[/b], and [b]Dr. Walker[/b], form the backbone of Lord Malakrogg’s surprise attack on Silverstone City.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/3e43107f6b114a1e2e4e234344c44ba5276322b2.png[/img]
Warhead is a one-man wrecking crew whose primary objective is to bring as much chaos and panic to Silverstone City as possible. There is a method to this madness however. Red bricks get targeted first, because Red tastes horribly, while Green bricks get a pass because they’ve only ever had nice things to say about him. While many of his peers wear special headgear to protect themselves from the mutating gas, Warhead has calculated that would require him to reduce his missile capacity by 8% which he has concluded is not worth the risk of breathing, “a little Yellow air.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/74b697d2136bb1a04c7809688c620436eb0ce8e9.png[/img]
Emperor Freudrich is a living legend from long-ago Bolvin lore. He is infamous for bringing Bolvin society the closest it has ever been to war hundreds of years ago. He has been resurrected through the use of Pale Yolk by the same secretive scientists that were discovered to be experimenting on the Chicken Tribes of Big Claw. Emperor has rigorously trained the Lord’s Vanguard into the elite fighting force they are today. In a textbook case of nominative determinism, Emperor Freudrich has never held the title of emperor; it simply happens to be his given name. A lifetime of being annoyed with this name is why he advised Lord Malakrogg to reconsider the Lord’s original alias, “Evilnone.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/028752ba12d43e2402d99cbd52428d899e4171fc.png[/img]
Doctors Huther and Newther had long, illustrious careers before their Pale Yolk atrocities were discovered. Even B.R.E.M. had a previous life as a well-respected member of the scientific community before deciding to make himself into, well, B.R.E.M. However, no such records exist or ever seem to have existed for the one who calls himself Dr. Walker which calls into question if he even has a doctorate.

[h2]New Legendary Fusions[/h2]
Malakrogg’s own royal guard is made up of his strongest creations: three Legendary Fusions who never seem to leave the Lord’s side. These Fusions will be revealed by members of our Content Creator program over the next few days.
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@WRLD_EATR]WRLD_EATR[/url] will be introducing [b]Roastevelt[/b], a furious warrior who pilots a mechanical suit designed by Lord Malakrogg and is considered by many to be the angriest Bolvin to ever live.
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@bitverse_andy]bitverse_andy[/url] will be introducing [b]Lux-0[/b], Malakrogg’s finest mechanical marvel before his obsession with biological mutations.
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Neflarian]Neflarian[/url] will be introducing [b]Octakill[/b], Emperor’s pet project to reverse the pacification Bolvins typically experience as they increase in size.
[/list]
[h2]New Mythic Fusion[/h2]
Lord Malakrogg is just as much a brutal monstrosity as he is an absolute genius of mechanics and biology. Every piece of equipment or mutant augmentation that empowers his mighty Vanguard seems to have been designed and built by Malakrogg himself. Very little else is known about this tyrannical behemoth at this time. His body seems entirely made of mutations on top of further mutations and bleeds a substance uncomfortably similar to a destabilized variation of Pale Yolk. At his core there appears to be two things, an unfortunate Bolvin who seems to be the nucleus of his excessive mutations and a solid bitridium pump to fuel his massive frame. Whomever the bright Bolvin at the center of Malakrogg was, it is obvious that even they have submitted to the Lord’s will. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/1e9c9d1007e026ecd857fa50a5707cdb8e0234e6.png[/img]

The all new World Boss, [i]Project: Goodall[/i], featuring Lord Malakrogg and his Vanguard will be coming to Bit Heroes Quest [b]this week at server reset time on [u]March 20th[/u][/b].

[i]Project: Goodall[/i] will feature our first instance of an [b]Ancient difficulty[/b] in addition to the usual Normal, Hard, and Heroic options. Defeating Lord Malakrogg on Ancient difficulty will earn you the [u]Unstable Bitridium[/u] you will need to supercharge your Tier 21 Harvester into one of five elemental options, but be prepared for a cooperative challenge equivalent to a new Ancient Dungeon being added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/263ef6c4e2547a0eb8a55a467a00f51d516a163f.png[/img]

notes.title: New World Boss, who dis?
notes.notes:
An all-new World Boss, [u][b]Lord Malakrogg[/b][/u], is coming soon to Bit Heroes Quest! Let’s take a look at what makes this World Boss unique and the awesome new gear he is introducing to the game.

First and foremost, it’s important to understand that World Bosses are typically added to the game as new late-game content that targets the current highest tier. However, introducing a new World Boss in this way would have one of the same key issues we’re currently facing with adding a new Zone; this new and exciting content would be inaccessible to any player not already at or near Tier 21.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/6e52d8d7da0cab81ff68739271946938e281630d.png[/img]
[i]Table of World Boss tiers from the community wiki[/i]

To get around this issue in a fun way, we are releasing this World Boss at three specific Tiers to create an early-game, mid-game, and late-game challenge that everyone can enjoy and earn meaningful loot from.

[h2]Tier 7[/h2]
At Tier 7, Lord Malakrogg will drop a Set and a pair of Mythics that will help you mitigate incoming damage and tank for your team.

The set’s mainhand weapon is an [b]axe[/b] with the following skills to keep you going in battle:
[list]
[*] [b]BSL-1: Minimize[/b] - 0SP: Damage closest enemy
[*] [b]BSL-1: Protect[/b] - 1SP: Shield self
[*] [b]BSL-2: Contain[/b] - 2SP: Drain closest enemy
[*] [b]BSL-3: Sterilize[/b] - 2SP: Damage target enemy
[*] [b]BSL-4: Decontaminate[/b] - 3SP: Spread heal
[/list]
The rest of the set is made of a [b]ring[/b], [b]head[/b] gear, and [b]body[/b] gear that combine to keep you and your team safe when you need it most:
[list]
[*] 2/4: Gain 50% Shields when you first drop below 50% Health	
[*] 3/4 Gain 10% Redirect while all teammates are alive	
[*] 4/4: Gain 15% Deflect when you're the last teammate alive
[/list]
The [u]new Mythics[/u] at this tier are a [b]necklace[/b] that provides 3% Deflect and an [b]offhand[/b] that provides 10% Block to round out your defensive options.

[h2]New Mechanic: Heartwood[/h2]
The gear from Tiers 14 and 21 feature a new mechanic called [u][b]Heartwood[/b][/u]. For each stack of Heartwood, that character gains 4% Air Resistance. Heartwood can be stacked up to four times.

[h2]Tier 14[/h2]
At Tier 14, Lord Malakrogg will drop a Set and a pair of Mythics that will allow you to channel the powers of the Earth element to keep your team healthy and hale.

The set’s mainhand weapon is a [b]sword[/b] with the following skills to limit the enemy’s offensive potential:
[list]
[*] [b]Thinning[/b] - 0SP: Root the closest two enemies
[*] [b]Optimal Chamber[/b] - 0SP: Shield target and add a stack of Heartwood to them
[*] [b]Selective Pickings[/b] - 1SP: Root the furthest enemy twice
[*] [b]Eradication[/b] - 2SP: Root the strongest enemy
[*] [b]Exponential Growth[/b] - 3SP: Consume all Heartwood stacks and heal team 10% for each stack consumed
[/list]
The rest of the set is made of a [b]ring[/b], an [b]offhand[/b], and [b]body[/b] gear that work together to maximize the support you can offer you allies:
[list]
[*] 2/4: 10% Revitalize	
[*] 3/4: +10% Dual Strike each normal hit. Resets on Double Strike	
[*] 4/4: 75% Chance to give a stack of Heartwood to all teammates at the start of your turn
[/list]
The [u]new Mythics[/u] at this tier are a [b]necklace[/b] that gives you 0.5% Healing Power for each 1% Earth Damage you have (up to 25%) and [b]head[/b] gear that gives you 2SP the first time you heal per battle, so you’ll always be stocked up to come in clutch.

[h2]Tier 21[/h2]
At Tier 21, Lord Malakrogg will drop a Set and a pair of Mythics so you can pelt the bad guys with hard-hitting rocks.

The set’s mainhand weapon is a [b]spear[/b] with the following skills to pulverize your foes:
[list]
[*] [b]Contagion[/b] - 0SP: Deal Earth damage to the three closest enemies
[*] [b]Yolk Culture[/b] - 1SP: Root the closest, furthest, and weakest enemy
[*] [b]Cull Weakness[/b] - 2SP: Deal Earth damage to the weakest enemy four times
[*] [b]Culture Overgrowth[/b] - 3SP: Deal Earth damage and Root the enemy team
[*] [b]Nutrient Depletion[/b] - 4SP: Root the weakest enemy. This skill has 20% more Double Strike
[/list]
The rest of the set is made of a [b]ring[/b], [b]head[/b] gear, and [b]body[/b] gear that work as one to grind your opponents into dust:
[list]
[*] 2/4: Gain 5% Dual Strike for each teammate alive	
[*] 3/4: 50% Chance to add a stack of Heartwood to a random teammate when you hit an enemy
[*] 4/4: Whenever a teammate gains 4 stacks of Heartwood, remove them and deal 250% damage to the weakest enemy	
[/list]
The [u]new Mythics[/u] at this tier are a [b]necklace[/b] that gives 0.5% Earth Damage for each 1% of Air Resistance you have and an [b]offhand[/b] that gives 2 stacks of [u]Heartwood[/u] to all teammates whenever an enemy dies because sometimes the best defense is an overwhelming offense!

[h2]Harvester: Supercharged[/h2]
This World Boss brings more than just new gear however. Lord Malakrogg will also drop a new [b]Ancient[/b] material that can be used to [u]reforge a fully uptiered and upgraded Harvester[/u] into one of five powerful elemental versions with new skills! Earning this material will take the same effort as earning any new Ancient material. So, be prepared to coordinate a detailed strategy with your fellow heroes, and we will be monitoring your attempts following the release to tune the challenge just right.

Until then, here is a sneak peak of just one skill from each Harvester variation:
[list]
[*] [u]Air[/u] | [b]Artery Slash[/b] – 0SP: Bleed the closest enemy twice
[*] [u]Earth[/u] | [b]Entangling Thorns [/b]– 1SP: Root all enemies
[*] [u]Fire[/u] | [b]Thermocharge[/b] – 1SP: Combust the target enemy and spread heal
[*] [u]Water[/u] | [b]Raincaller's Grace[/b] – 4SP: Spread heal and execute 2 random skills
[*] [u]Electric[/u] | [b]Volt Requiem[/b] – 4SP: Shock weakest and execute 2 random skills
[/list]
Before Lord Malakrogg releases, we’ll have another update to share with you that overviews the cool [u][b]new Fusions[/b][/u] coming to the game. Be on the lookout for our next announcement soon!

notes.title: Halloween PvP Rewards and Sardinex

Voodoo Dolls have unintentionally not been dropping from the PvP mode since our most recent server reset. We have corrected this issue and have set them to [u]drop at double the original rate in PvP only[/u] for the rest of the event to compensate. We will also be adding a one-time purchase of [b]51 Voodoo Dolls for 1 Voodoo Doll[/b] to the event shop that will be available to everyone.

Furthermore, we need to amend our previous announcements that said Sardinex would be available until November 8th. While Sardinex [u]typically[/u] remains in town for an extra day following an event, the launch of our Bitversary event on the 7th means he will be too preoccupied to continue giving out the cool rewards from Halloween. Please remember to bring your Voodoo Dolls to Sardinex [u][b]before the server reset[/b][/u] this Thursday, November 7th.

Enjoy the rest of this year’s Halloween event and we’ll see you at The Bitversary soon!

notes.title: New Runes, Enchants, and Augments!
notes.notes:
The Bit Heroes meta is seeing a shake-up this week as we add more than 50 brand new augments, enchants, and runes to the game! Redefine your best builds and explore new niche options with additional sources of Barrier, Accuracy, Ricochet Chance, and Team Enrage for your Hero, as well as your Familiars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/93fd98aa371171a5055adfecd1e6fb115f138bad.png[/img]

A new collection of Xirtanium Skeletal Linings provide buffs to both defensive and offensive Familiars that are either below or above specified health thresholds. And new Microprocessing Stabilizing chips bring an array of unique effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/f37c69d5dfb3794e6b5f10eeaa49cea2d3de5b6e.png[/img]

Meanwhile, your Hero can also equip new Runes that allow you to access some of the same buffs that are now available to Familiars in addition to their own variety of new abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/aa689e9cb59efc3d00da40141304dca1ed54798c.png[/img]

As part of today’s server release, we will be closing the server down 10 minutes earlier than we normally would to ensure these new items are potentially included when you claim your weekly rewards from Invasion and PvP.

We look forward to seeing what fresh ideas you all cook up with these newly added items!

notes.title: Feline Festival
notes.notes:
If you didn’t know, June is Adopt-a-Cat month! Beginning right after the peak of “kitten season,” this month is the perfect time to consider adding a new feline friend to your home!

We will be celebrating our own love of cats this month with some [b]new cosmetics[/b]! Sardinex will even be making an unscheduled visit starting on [u]June 6th[/u] to exchange these cosmetics and more for the Grey Fish that you will be able to find in various game modes while the event is live! You can also look forward to a [i]+50% Daily Bonus[/i] to [b][u]everything [/u][/b]during these two weeks.

Since this is a Special Event, Sardinex didn’t have time to gather all the usual goodies that he brings to our regular rotation of Seasonal Events. Material Boxes, Energy Boxes, and even a Bitgor will all be available for exchange, but you’ll need to wait until our rapidly approaching [b]Summer Fireworks[/b] event to discover what new familiar Sardinex has [strike]bribed[/strike] persuaded most recently.

There will also be one especially cool cat cosmetic available for purchase in our shop! Those who can offer up enough [u][b]gold[/b][/u] to match its expensive taste can look forward to a stylish new kitty companion joining them on their next quest.

While you're collecting those Grey Fish, we encourage those of you with the space to do so to check your local shelters and consider adopting a cat of your own!

notes.title: Our next Mobileversary will soon be here!
notes.notes:
Join the jubilant festivities as Bit Heroes Quest Mobileversary celebrates [u][b]seven years[/b][/u] of thrilling adventures! The realm is brimming with excitement as Sardinex arrives with a treasure trove of celebratory items to mark this momentous occasion.
[list]
[*] Say hello to iTrolf X, the newest addition to your roster of familiars
[*] Collect Phone Cards to spend on dazzling cosmetics and exclusive mounts
[/list]
This Mobileversary we will be making a small adjustment when compared to past events. Typically, events in Bit Heroes feature boosted rates for all of the different Daily Bonuses during that week. For example, Friday’s +50% experience bonus might be +100% during an event.

For this year’s Mobileversary, we will instead be replacing the usual Daily Bonus schedule with a +50% bonus to [b]EVERYTHING[/b] all event long. This means that experience gain, item find, capture rate, [u]and[/u] gold find will [u]all[/u] be boosted [u]every[/u] day of the week during the event.

We hope you enjoy these changes, and we will be monitoring the feedback that you share on our Discord to keep in mind as we plan out future events.

notes.title: Hardcore
notes.notes:
BIT HEROES QUEST HARDCORE CHALLENGE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/191f2592f65f49facc22dcc12fa6e4aeaffcca92.png[/img]

Heroes wanted! Get ready for the greatest of challenges in Bit Heroes Quest - Hardcore.

During this event, you must survive as long as possible while you traverse through your adventure. The catch? You only have 1 life! If you die, you will have to create a new hero to continue in the competition.

Stay alive, Heroes! Only the strongest, smartest, and most hardcore will survive!

Bit Heroes Quest Hardcore 2023 event starts on August 24th 3:00PM PDT and ends on September 6th at 3:00PM PDT.

Event features:
You only have 1 life. Don't die!
You can surrender and escape death, BUT DON'T EVER DIE!
There are 3 Leaderboards for this challenge: Free-2-play, Paid, and NFT.
Everyone begins the challenge on the Free-to-Play track, until they make a purchase in the game. Once you pay for any microtransaction, you will be entered into the Spender track.
Your goal is to level up as much as you can, and push as many flags and zones as you can in the span of 2 weeks.
Trials/Gauntlet + Invasions will also count toward your final overall score in the race. PVP will not be tracked.
For the first time ever, we are releasing a special leaderboard that you can check out here! 
We have prizes for the 30 winners of each leaderboard: Free-to-play/Paid/NFT.

How to participate?
Step 1. Create a new character once the contest begins.

Only new characters will be eligible for prizes. We recommend playing the web version of Bit Heroes Quest.

To create a new character, simply sign up for a new Kongregate.com account and load up the game.

Do not use a pre-existing Kongregate account, or you will be disqualified!
Do not change your name during the event!

Note: If you’re a mobile player, we’ve provided a special set of instructions for you here. 


Step 2. Register your new character using the form below.
You can fill out this form any time before the contest ends (September 6th, 3:00pm PDT). Make sure to fill this form out correctly - include your character name AND tag. 

Not filling the form out correctly with accurate information will make your submission invalid and considered ineligible to receive any rewards.

Step 3. Play your new character without dying.
Compete for the top prizes. If you die at any point in the game, redo these steps to try again!

All Speed Run characters must be made after the event starts to qualify. 

Special Rules
No guilds. No friends. Just you and your familiars. The moment you join a guild, make friends, or join friends in a world boss, this will cause immediate defeat!
You can make a new Kongregate account and Bit Heroes Quest character if you die. Just make sure to follow the registration rules and start over!
For those who have current ownership of an NFT account, you can opt in to enter the NFT leaderboard.
You will still need to make a brand-new Kongregate account and Bit Heroes Quest character to run on.
Players who purchase an NFT on the speed running account will be automatically moved to the NFT track.

For more detailed information about the rules, please visit [url=https://www.kongregate.com/pages/bhq-hardcore-challenge]this link[/url]. 

Got any questions? Join the official [url=https://kon.gg/BitverseDiscord]Discord server[/url] for more information and FAQs.

Hey Heroes!

As we mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/666860/announcements/detail/3038209085752751888]last Steam Announcement[/url], the Steam Unity Beta has launched! 

If you are a Mac user we have also unlocked the ability for you to give Bit Heroes a try. However, [b]for Mac users, Bit Heroes is only playable via the Beta path.[/b] To play you will [b]NEED[/b] to follow the instructions below before launching the game.

[b]How do I access the Beta path in Steam?[/b]
1) -- Fully exit and reopen Steam.
2) -- Find Bit Heroes among your list of games within your Library.
3) -- Right-click on “Bit Heroes” and click “Properties” in the drop-down.
4) -- Click on the “Beta” tab found on the properties pop-up window.
5) -- Select the ‘beta - Public Beta’ path via the drop-down and then click the “x” icon on the window.
6) -- Please wait for the game to finish updating before launching the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/6ae2392133361b67ec07c574149353bfae5311b0.png[/img]

notes.title: New Unity Beta build available to play!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Heroes![/b]

We are once again happy to announce that we are hitting our next milestone in the ongoing Unity port rollout. Today at roughly 10:30 AM PST we are setting up our soft launch for Steam! Similar to our Web soft launch we want to make sure players have the option to opt into the Beta path and still have the option to play the stable build if they so choose. 

Although we fully appreciate those of you that take the time to test the new Unity version of Bit Heroes on Steam please recognize that this is still considered a Beta and you may experience a few bugs/issues. If you run into any issues with the Unity version please let the developers know by responding in the #unity-port-issues channel found on our official [url=https://discord.gg/BitHeroes]Discord (discord.gg/BitHeroes)[/url].

[code]DISCLAIMER:
Playing on the Unity version will still be using your real account and as a result, any items consumed or used while playing on the Beta version will also be exhausted within the current version of the game as well. 

We will not be able to refund or replace any resources you choose to use while playing on the beta version of the game. If you do come across an issue please report it to the devs immediately and DO NOT continue to use any further resources in the area that you discovered the issue. If you wish to continue playing and using resources in that area then you can return to the stable build of the game at any time by following the instructions given above. You can still also play the stable version on your mobile device as normal.[/code]

[b]How do I access the Beta path in Steam?[/b]

1) -- Fully exit and reopen Steam.
2) -- Find Bit Heroes among your list of games within your Library.
3) -- Right-click on “Bit Heroes” and click “Properties” in the drop-down.
4) -- Click on the “Beta” tab found on the properties pop-up window.
5) -- Select the ‘beta - Public Beta’ path via the drop-down and then click the “x” icon on the window.
6) -- Please wait for the game to finish updating before launching the game.

[b]How do I stop playing the Beta version in Steam?[/b] Similar to the steps you had to take to join the Beta you will want to go back click the Beta tab within the game’s properties window and deselect the Beta path so that it reads ‘None.’ Please follow the steps found above if you need a refresher on how to access the Beta tab. After you deselect the Beta path you will still need to wait for the game to update and relaunch before reaccessing the stable version. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30636404/6ae2392133361b67ec07c574149353bfae5311b0.png[/img]

Thanks so much to all of you that have shown understanding and support while we have worked to get this build out the door. If you would like to help test this build then please head on over to [url=https://discord.gg/BitHeroes]#unity-port-issues[/url] for a few more details on how to help.

[b]Much love,[/b]
[b]The Entire Bit Heroes Development Team[/b]

notes.title: Unity Update 1/8/21
notes.notes:
[u][b]UNITY UPDATE:[/b][/u]

First off, we want to extend our sincerest thanks to everyone that has been helping us test the Unity beta path on Kongregate.com over the last few weeks. With your help, we’ve been able to locate and resolve several issues during the soft launch period.

Due to the overwhelmingly positive feedback and support provided by our awesome community we now feel confident enough to fully transition the Web version over to Unity. This means that we will be removing the selector from the web version and default all players to the Unity build. We plan to have this change take effect on Monday (01/11/21) at around roughly 11:00 AM PST.

If any changes need to be made to this timeline we will make sure to update everyone on [url=https://discord.gg/TTzksvhK]Discord[/url], so stay tuned-in for updates! For the time being, we will continue to leave the [url=https://discord.gg/TTzksvhK]#unity-port-issues[/url] channel open to help us identify and resolve Unity-specific issues as they may crop up.

[u][b]WHAT’S UP NEXT?[/b][/u]

We’re sure many of you are curious as to what will be forthcoming barring an expectedly successful transition to Unity on web this upcoming Monday. Aside from continuing to monitor the web build for potential issues, we will begin shifting our focus to finishing the ports for all of our officially supported platforms. The first of which will be Steam. Similar to the web build, we are hoping to have a public Beta for the Steam Unity port soon. Once we have more details to share we will announce it officially.

Thanks again to everyone that has taken part in the Beta and provided such invaluable feedback along the way!!

notes.title: 📢 New World Boss & Resource Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
This week’s reset will be packed with new content and changes to help you make the most of your bit adventures.

[b]A new World Boss launches on Thursday (July 23) along with a new resource that will be used for World Boss (WB) encounters, instead of Energy.
[/b]

Using our community’s feedback to improve the Bit Heroes experience, we are updating World Boss encounters to use a new resource: Xeals. This change will free up Energy-- players will no longer have to choose between farming Quest (flags & dungeons) or World Boss. You’ll be able to do both!

Xeals will start with a cap of 5 which can be increased by Guild Perks, and will regen at the same rate as Badges (45 minutes). It will require 1 Xeal to summon 1 WB. With regular caps and regen, about 640 Energy per day will be available for you to dedicate to Quest encounters for progression or farming experience, familiars, gems, and more.

To help this update go smoothly, we have a few more changes and additions:

[list]
[*] A temporary option to trade Energy Pack for Xeal Buckets will be available for 1 week. A Xeal Bucket is worth 20 Xeals.
[*] A few Xeals will be gifted to players as a launch celebration of the new World Boss!
[*] After the first week, the conversion rate of Energy to Xeals will changed to match the conversion rate of Energy to Shards
[*] Xeals will be added to the Guild Shop.
[*] Xeals Cap Increase up to 9 will be available as a Guild Perk.
[*] Xeals will be added to regular Shop offers, bundles, and sales.
[*] Xeals will soon be added to the Daily Login Bonus Calendar Rewards.
[*] Xeals will be added as one of the possible rewards for ‘Free Stuff’ videos.
[/list]

We are reviewing the feedback and open to making some adjustments after we have a chance to collect and review data and the overall community response.  We really like that this gives players the option to dedicate Energy to Quest and hope it will liven up the World Boss lobbies with more activity.

If you have feedback or questions to share, please [url=https://kon.gg/BitHeroesForums]share on our forums[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/xSNHnKT]Discord server[/url]!

[b]Thank you for playing Bit Heroes, and good luck in your adventures![/b]

<3

A contest wherein you create an alt account and progress as much as you can before the new tier launches.

Each item in these boxes are weighted the same. This means that with each pull, you have an equal chance to get any of the items that you have not already pulled from that box.

When you pull from the box, the item is removed from that box. This means you cannot get a duplicate if you pull multiple times.

notes.title: Special Announcement!
notes.notes:
We here at Juppiomenz are very pleased to announce that the long awaited Steam release is finally happening! Tomorrow, 12/13/2017, Bit Heroes will be released on Steam for everyone to download and play. It will be free to play on this platform and connect to the same servers that are currently live for the game. You can start fresh with a brand new character, or link up and log into your existing account through Kongregate. And for the first time, you’ll be able to play Bit Heroes in full screen which is super exciting for all you streamers out there. We’d like to thank everyone for their patience and we hope you all are as excited as we are to bring Bit Heroes to this new platform. 

~Juppiomenz Team
